review_disposition.independent_review: Opus read the final CAD and deposited-path reports. No blocking defect identified.
review_disposition.bracket_bridge_followup: The smaller regions requested in review were checked on both original and reopened paths. The central 3.2 mm bridge is backed at both ends. Outer edge runs up to 3.9 mm have one end backed. Root crossbar paths span 7.2 mm between supports, with shorter internal runs printed across the same layer.
review_disposition.physical_limits: Board dimensions and hole pitch remain photo-derived. Fit, print surface quality, spring fatigue, clip retention and click force need the first physical trial.
